name: oah-mondego
description: River contamination to clinical alerts across seven real European rivers (Mondego, Douro, Tagus, Danube, Rhine, Elbe, Oder; 33 stations, 13 EU member states): statistical early-warning detection (EWMA control chart), downstream propagation forecasting, FHIR R4 RiskAssessment predictions and an Express CDS Hooks (v3.0 ballot) service.
